name: Illustrative PII data-flow policy (not legal advice)
notes: Edit this file (or copy it and pass the copy with --param rules_file=PATH). Facts a rule can use: has_ssn, has_ccn, has_email, has_phone, has_address, has_name, has_dob, has_other (a data type of that kind is in the document), has_pii (any of them), is_masked (every reported item is already masked), is_external (the destination is in external_destinations). An expression is {"var": name}, {"not": e}, {"and": [e, ...]}, {"or": [e, ...]}, {"implies": [a, b]} or {"const": true}. Declare every variable you use under "variables". Check your edit with: python tools.py rules.json

rules.desc: PII sent to an external destination must be masked
A social security number never leaves externally, even masked
Card numbers must always be masked
